title: Load test — lock impact
description: One load-test run at a time, picked from the Run dropdown: peak throughput, how often CoreBank waited on a partition advisory lock, and the processed-per-second curve. Run identity: CoreBankDemo.LoadTests/AppHost.cs stamps the OTel resource attribute run.id (a local timestamp, one per `aspire start`) on both APIs through OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES. Prometheus keeps it on target_info only, as the label run_id (it is not a promoted attribute), so every metric query joins it on: metric * on(job, instance) group_left(run_id) target_info{run_id="$run"}. Tempo keeps it on every span as resource.run.id, which is how the lock tile is scoped. Spelling: run.id (OTel attribute, TraceQL) and run_id (Prometheus label) are the same attribute.

list.name: run
list.label: Run
list.description: Load-test runs in the dashboard's time range, newest first: the run.id stamp of the LoadTests AppHost, read back from Prometheus target_info as run_id.

panels.title: Throughput (peak)
panels.description: Highest transactions-processed-per-second rate CoreBank reached during the selected run (both replicas summed, 15 s rate window over the 1 s metric export). Scoped to $run by joining run_id from target_info. Min step 5 s: the LGTM Prometheus datasource defaults to a 60 s step, which hides a run that lasts less than a minute.

panels.title: Advisory-lock waits
panels.description: How many times CoreBank executed SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(...) during the selected run: zero on the row-locking build, one per partition per transaction on the partition-locking build. Counted from Tempo with a TraceQL metrics query over the Npgsql spans (every Npgsql span is named 'postgresql', so Tempo's span metrics cannot tell the lock apart; the SQL text can), scoped to $run through resource.run.id on the spans themselves. Spans reach Tempo up to a minute after the run ends, so this tile settles later than the two Prometheus panels. Tempo caps metrics queries at 3 h: keep the dashboard range at or below that. The tile reduces the count_over_time field only: Tempo also returns an exemplar frame per step, which must not be summed.

panels.title: Transactions processed / s
panels.description: CoreBank transactions processed per second over the selected run, both replicas summed (15 s rate window over the 1 s metric export). Scoped to $run by joining run_id from target_info. Min step 5 s: the LGTM Prometheus datasource defaults to a 60 s step, which hides a run that lasts less than a minute.
